lines.heard: Put T equal 0 and P equal 100 into the formula. 100 equal P not E to the power K times 0.
lines.said: Put T equals zero and P equals one hundred into the formula: one hundred equals P nought E to the power K times zero.

lines.heard: E is involved, so we use LN, which is log base E.
lines.said: E is involved, so we use L N, which is log base E.

lines.heard: Now take ln of both sides, ln of E to the power 7.5k equals ln2.
lines.said: Now take L N of both sides: L N of E to the power seven point five K equals L N two.

lines.heard: Divide both sides by 7.5 K = LN2 over 7.5
lines.said: Divide both sides by seven point five: K equals L N two over seven point five.

lines.heard: That is 0.0924 correct to three significant figures.
lines.said: That is zero point zero nine two four, correct to three significant figures.
